subject: Gen3 P1.2 model: service-stable presentation owner passes 13/13 + 100k adversarial events
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-reviewer-presentation-owner-20261001T230350Z. Isolated pure-Kotlin PresentationOwner model compiled and passed 13/13 tests, including a 100,000-event fixed-seed adversarial stream. Model reproduces legacy intent-without-presentation and frozen-host identity collision; Gen3 owner uses service-stable hostLeaseId + global attemptSequence and exact serviceEpoch/closeCycleId/transitionGeneration/visualAttemptId/contentLeaseId/renderPath. It separates REQUESTED/HOST_READY/SUBMITTED/PRESENTED from evidence strength. Frame commit and transaction commit never assert physical visibility. API35 transaction completed callback can assert PRESENTED_CALLBACK even without a valid present-fence timestamp; valid fence upgrades evidence to PRESENT_FENCE. Proposed FROZEN_VIEW path requires a draw-synchronized SurfaceControl transaction completion (or equivalent real presentation primitive) before asserting PRESENTED; frame commit alone remains insufficient. Reversal/new attempt invalidates stale completions. R&D model only; Android integration and Fold7 field validation required.
